title: Mini F1b Goldendoodles
temperament: Red mini F1b Goldendoodles are highly intelligent, affectionate, and low-shedding companions known for their eager-to-please nature and playful, family-friendly energy.
cardDesc: Zoey and Cedar's red mini F1b Goldendoodles bring together the ultimate low-to-no shedding coat, bright intelligence, and a sweet, people-loving personality. These gorgeous red pups are eager to please, gentle with families, and ready to fill your home with playful affection.
